primary_sources.title: NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPU Architecture v1.1
primary_sources.interpretation: FP16 arithmetic gain is modest; bandwidth/cache gains larger. FP4 sparse AI TOPS are not this FP16 workload. INT32 pipelines improve some mixed instruction workloads, but this experiment does not isolate that contribution.

primary_sources.title: NVIDIA RTX5060 family specifications
primary_sources.facts: RTX5060Ti has 16GB and8GB GDDR7 variants,180W reference TGP, compute capability12.0. Actual rental is16GB. Product search cache lists448GB/s; current rendered full-spec table omits bandwidth.

primary_sources.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Tuning Guide12.8
primary_sources.interpretation: Compute12.0 and10.0 have different limits; B200 HBM/NVLink/shared-memory claims must not be assigned to consumer RTX50 cards.

primary_sources.title: PyTorch CUDA semantics / CUDA Graphs
primary_sources.interpretation: Graph replay reduces CPU launch overhead; dynamic shapes/control flow may prevent reuse. Existing fork hybrid runner combines its Triton patches and CUDA Graphs.

primary_sources.title: NVIDIA MPS architecture
primary_sources.interpretation: Independent contexts ordinarily time slice compute queues; MPS permits cross-process concurrent scheduling when resources permit. More VRAM does not itself guarantee more throughput.

primary_sources.title: Dissecting the NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture with Microbenchmarks, Jarmusch et al.2025
primary_sources.interpretation: This primary study tests RTX5080 versus H100 PCIe; it reports both gains and regressions. It is not a5070-versus4070 OmniVoice measurement, so our direct tests determine the recommendation.
